NoRepositories: No repositories found. Check GitHub Login and access permissions.
Pick: Choose import destination (this exact folder will be used)
Success: Project successfully imported and permanently linked: {0}
Cancelled: Import cancelled. No new link was saved. Temporary import folders, if any, are retained for inspection.
FailureHint: No new link was saved. Temporary .ai-github-import-* folders beside the destination may remain for inspection. Inspect the destination before retrying or choose another/empty folder.
Preflight: Import: checking Git, GitHub login, remote and destination …
Existing: Import: awaiting a decision for the existing repository …
Updating: Import: checking and performing a safe fast-forward …
InvalidRemote: Invalid GitHub remote address. HTTPS and SSH addresses on github.com without embedded credentials are supported.
InvalidPath: Choose an absolute local destination that is neither a file nor a drive root.
UnsafePath: Unsafe destination: symbolic link, reparse point, worktree or a folder inside another repository. Choose a standalone folder.
OccupiedTarget: The destination contains files and is not a supported Git repository. Existing files are preserved.
ForeignRepository: The existing repository belongs to a different remote address. Import blocked; existing files are preserved.
GitUnavailable: Git is not installed or could not be started. Install Git and try again.
AuthenticationRequired: GitHub login or credential setup is missing. Run GitHub Login and check access permissions. No additional token is required.
RemoteUnavailable: Repository unavailable or identity not confirmed. Check network and access permissions, including access to private repositories.
GitFailed: Git operation failed. Check network, disk space, repository and Git setup. No reset or force-pull was performed.
UnsafeUpdate: Update blocked: local/ignored files, Git lock, interrupted operation, missing upstream or divergent history. Save your changes and check the branch, or choose link only.
FileAccess: The destination cannot be used safely. Check the path, write permissions, free space and whether other applications are using it.
Persistence: The local link could not be saved. Imported files are preserved. Check project store write permissions and link again.
